result:
Each query is my first and only attempt, written from the page alone and not run. The task labels are J1 to J14, so I used `J` in the answer lines instead of the `H` in your template.

Three assumptions I could not check against the page:
- **J11:** I treated "status code 500 or higher" as "starts with 5", because the page has no way to read a number out of a string and the log only has 5xx codes.
- **J3, J5, J6, J11:** I assumed `coalesce` and `groupBy` work as their names suggest, and that a name like `d` stays readable inside a quoted modifier.
- **J12:** I used `parseJson` on the score string to get a number, since the page says nothing is converted implicitly.

J1: /data | filter ~/active | filter ~(/address/city | type | eq ::string !| false) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
J2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid" !| false) * (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
J3: :r / | /dependencies | combine (r | /devDependencies) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | :m / | keys * (:k / | keyword | append "@" | append (m | at k))
J4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (/assignee/login !| "unassigned" | keyword) | groupBy ~(/) | * count
J5: :d /defaults | /services | filter ~(/enabled | ne false !| true) | * {:name /name :timeout (at :timeout | coalesce (d | /timeout)) :retries (at :retries | coalesce (d | /retries))} | sort ~/name
J6: filter ~(at :durationMs | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~(/service | keyword) | * (* /durationMs | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round 1)
J7: filter ~(/stock | gt 0 !| false) | sort ~/price | reverse | take 3 * /name
J8: groupBy ~(/dept | keyword) | * (* (at :skills | coalesce []) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort)
J9: filter ~(/role | lower | eq "db") * [(/region | eq "eu-west") (/cpu/cores | gte 8 !| false)] | flat | every ~(eq true)
J10: split "; " * split ", " | flat | * (split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort
J11: lines * split " " | filter ~(/3 | startsWith "5" !| false) | * /2 | :p / | distinct * (:x / | {:path x :count (p | filter ~(eq x) | count)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /path]) | take 2
J12: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0 !| false) | groupBy ~(/1 | keyword) | * (* (/2 | parseJson) | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round 2)
J13: lines | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") * split "==" | indexBy ~(/0 | lower | keyword) | * /1
J14: * {:t /title :l (at :comments | coalesce [] * (at :likes | coalesce 0) | sum)} | sort ~/l | last | /t
